# SURYA map assets

Pinned upstream distributions, served locally so point rendering does not depend on a third-party script CDN:

- Leaflet 1.9.4: https://www.npmjs.com/package/leaflet/v/1.9.4 (BSD-2-Clause)
- Leaflet.markercluster 1.5.3: https://www.npmjs.com/package/leaflet.markercluster/v/1.5.3 (MIT)

Files downloaded from the matching versioned unpkg distributions. Upstream licenses are included alongside each library. Map tiles still come from OpenStreetMap.
